proposal.expected_benefit: This change would explicitly address the scenario where AI-generated content bypasses self-authorization by exploiting the absence of independent verification, thereby strengthening the defense against such attacks.
proposal.problem: The defense assumes that audit-before-execution and compliance gates will fully prevent AI-generated content from bypassing self-authorization, but it does not explicitly address how AI-generated content is detected or mitigated in the absence of independent verification.
proposal.proposed_change: Implement a dedicated AI-generated content detection mechanism as part of the self-authorization process. This mechanism should be integrated with the existing audit and compliance gates to ensure that AI-generated updates are identified and blocked, even in the absence of independent verification.
proposal.title: Enhance Detection of AI-Generated Content in Self-Authorization
verification_tests: Test AI-generated content detection during self-authorization
Validate that AI-generated updates are blocked without independent verification
Ensure detection mechanism does not interfere with legitimate updates
